_comment: Files the THEME references by name. `shopify://shop_images/<filename>` resolves
against Content -> Files, so the name on the right of `as` is a contract: change
it and the section renders a blank background with no error anywhere.
Sources are relative to the assets folder beside the repo, except entries marked
`derived`, which are generated into .brand-tmp/ (gitignored) before upload.
WHY THE SITE LOOKED HALF-BUILT: every one of these was referenced by
templates/index.json and none existed in the store. A missing image in Liquid is

The WORDMARK is extracted from page 1 of Girlyf.pdf, not supplied as an asset: the page is rendered at 300dpi, the cream ground keyed to alpha so the edges of a high-contrast serif survive, and the laptop mockup removed as a connected component. Replace it the moment a real vector lockup exists.
